registry에서 valid 정통 factor 선별 (Z_Score_Aligned 사용, C13 정합), (b) **Lag features 200**: 1m / 3m / 6m / 12m lag × 50 factors, (c) **Rolling stats 250**: mean / std / skew / kurtosis × 5 windows × 50 factors, (d) **Sector interaction 100**: 26 sectors × top 5 factors interaction terms, (e) **Regime conditional 80**: 4-bucket regime × top 20 factors, (f) **Macro lag 30**: FRED + ECOS 1m/3m lag, (g) **CAPM/FF3 residual 50**: cross-section regression residual factors, (h) **Cross-section ranks 100**: rank percentile features. 총 ~700~960 features generated → screening 후 final 200~500. **ML 정통 학술
